claims.text: Addis’s mayor attributes a royal settlement to Taytu; the date does not resolve foundation alternatives. Eritrea’s ministry describes Massawa’s separate Egyptian and Italian institutions. FRUS transmits Empress Mennen’s invasion protest and an Italian notice claiming government in Addis. An occupying claim establishes neither legitimacy, consent nor universal control.
